pages.text: With $(bold)no animals attached$(reset), grounded players can push along the wagon’s length. Push from behind to move forward, or from in front to move backward. The body and axle areas can be used.$(br2)Standing on the wagon, flying or being airborne does not push it. Sideways pressure does not cause strafing.

A seated driver can steer while someone pushes. Pushing is slow and useful for docking; it does not replace draft animals.$(br2)To restore a wagon to blocks, start with a folded jack and park roughly above it. Exact pixel alignment is unnecessary.
